entries.name: Bitcoin mainnet
entries.notes: Mainnet is out of scope by default; verification covers network-independent repo tools for 24-word BIP-39 generation with an empty passphrase and watch-only derivation at the fixed path m/84'/0'/0'/0/i, not live-network flows. M-38 requires 6 confirmations as policy only, without enforcement code; no transaction-construction, signing or broadcast code exists in the repo; BTC/ETH/TRX share xpub version 0488b21e, so cross-chain xpub misuse is undetectable from serialisation alone.

entries.name: TON mainnet
entries.notes: Mainnet is out of scope by default; verified repo tooling is network-independent and generation-only, using 24-word BIP-39 with an empty passphrase and fixed path m/44'/607'/0'; TON has no xpub and no watch-only derivation.
